title: Clothing Video Ad Templates | AIVideosUGC
description: Make clothing video ads for streetwear, everyday fashion, and luxury apparel. Add a flat photo, put the piece on a person, and download a reel in minutes.
h1: Clothing Video Ad Templates for Brands
eyebrow: A Reel From One Flat Photo
lead: Make styled video ads for everyday fashion, streetwear, and luxury apparel, in minutes, with AI.
steps_h2: How to Make a Clothing Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: You leave with a reel of the garment on a person. Add the photo, name the move, and download.

steps.d: Upload the garment flat, with the collar, cuffs, and hem in frame. That outline is what the move has to keep.
Name one full turn in soft daylight, or paste the product link. The move should keep the collar, cuffs, and hem.
Get captions on the turn and an AI avatar wearing the piece. Match the color to the flat photo before you post.

faq.q: What are clothing video ad templates?
faq.a: Ready-made ad formats with AI avatars, spoken lines, and hooks that show apparel worn and styled. No model booking and no studio day. Drop in your product and download a video ad in minutes.

faq.q: How does a clothing template build the ad?
faq.a: Upload your product photos. The tool builds a creator-style clip around them, with a script, a hook, and a spoken line for apparel shoppers. No casting and no styling day.

faq.q: What clothing can these templates cover?
faq.a: Streetwear, casual wear, activewear, occasion wear, and luxury fashion. If someone can wear it, a format is ready to sell that piece.

faq.q: Can I make several versions for different styles?
faq.a: Yes. Make several versions across products, seasons, and audiences without starting over. That helps labels with a large catalogue or frequent drops.

faq.q: Who should use these clothing templates?
faq.a: Online apparel brands and clothing labels that need steady creative without model shoots or influencer programs.

faq.q: Can I use them if I have never edited a video?
faq.a: Yes. You do not need editing skills or a styling background. Upload your product photos, adjust the message, and publish the clothing video.

faq.q: How fast can I get a clothing video ad?
faq.a: You can go from a product photo to a finished video ad in minutes. No model booking, and no studio wait.

faq.q: Which frame and length can I download?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for a phone feed. Also 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You can post to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook.

faq.q: How many credits does a clothing video cost?
faq.a: A clip spends 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I run the reel as an ad or in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Post it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook, speak the line in another language, and make another move from the same photo. The person on screen is an AI avatar.
